people.name: Andi Deris
people.extract: Andreas "Andi" Deris is a German singer, best known as one of the three co-lead vocalists of the power metal band Helloween, and co-founder and former lead singer of the metal band Pink Cream 69.
highlights: Co-lead vocalist for power metal band Helloween.
Co-founder and lead singer of Pink Cream 69.

people.name: Ernest MacMillan
people.extract: Sir Ernest Alexander Campbell MacMillan was a Canadian conductor, composer and organist. He was Canada's only "Musical Knight", and is widely regarded as being Canada's pre-eminent musician from the 1920s through the 1950s. His contributions to the development of music in Canada were sustained and varied, as conductor, performer, composer, administrator, lecturer, adjudicator, writer, humourist, and statesman.
highlights: Pre-eminent Canadian musician from the 1920s through the 1950s.

people.name: Isaac P. Rodman
people.extract: Isaac Peace Rodman was a Rhode Island banker, politician, and a Union Army brigadier general in the American Civil War, who was mortally wounded at the Battle of Antietam.
highlights: Union Army brigadier general in the American Civil War.
Mortally wounded at the Battle of Antietam.
